name: Kaenbio
summary: E-commerce and wellness institute dedicated to organic cosmetics.
description: Kaenbio is an online shop and institute dedicated to organic and natural cosmetics. Based in Granville and Agon-Coutainville, the site offers a wide range of products that respect the environment and the skin, as well as personalized treatments. Built with WooCommerce, it delivers a smooth shopping experience and an elegant showcase for natural products.
about_client: Kaenbio is a family business based in Normandy, in Granville and Agon-Coutainville. Passionate about well-being and nature, they offer a curated selection of organic and natural cosmetics for the whole family. In addition to their online shop, they welcome clients in their institute for personalized treatments, combining expertise and eco-friendly products.
about_project: The mission was to design a performant and aesthetic e-commerce platform that reflects the brand's natural and premium identity. The site, built on WooCommerce, provides intuitive navigation that helps users explore product ranges (face, body, hair, etc.). Particular attention was given to a clean, soothing design and SEO optimization to strengthen local and national visibility.
